text: What happened in Krakow, Poland? Market shooting leaves 5 dead on Nov. 7. A man opened fire from his car on a crowded market in Krakow, Poland, on Saturday, Nov. 7, killing at least five people and wounding about a dozen others. Police shot the gunman, who was taken into custody. The attack happened at the Main Market Square, the historic center of Poland's second-largest city.. A mass shooting in Krakow's Main Market Square on Saturday, Nov. 7, left at least five people dead and about a dozen injured. Authorities are still investigating the gunman's background.. The attack took place around 3 p.m. Local time. Krakow police said the driver began firing at random people from inside his vehicle as it moved through the square. Police officers are counted among the wounded. Police wounded the suspect during an exchange of fire and took him to a hospital for treatment. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said he was receiving updates from the interior minister and that investigators were examining the motive and every circumstance of the attack. The U.S. Ambassador to Poland, Tom Rose, called the attack a savage and murderous act that had shattered the peace of the country and said America stands with Poland. Krakow lies about 250 kilometers, or 155 miles, south of Warsaw. The shooting is notable because it struck the central square of a major tourist city during a busy Saturday afternoon. As of the latest reports, the motive has not been publicly confirmed.
